items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: A contribution-style heatmap of daily activity over 26 weeks, with a diagonal reveal, weekday and month labels, hover/focus tooltips, and a Less-to-More legend.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated beam
items.description: A live routing diagram where beams of light travel from three sources through a gateway to three destinations, with hover and keyboard inspection.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated tabs
items.description: A segmented view switcher whose pill glides between tabs on a spring while the panel slides and the card height follows.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Revenue over time with a self-drawing line, morphing ranges, and a pointer crosshair.

items.name: avatar-spread
items.title: Avatar spread
items.description: A collaborator stack that fans out on hover or focus, with status dots, per-person tooltips and a line that follows the person under the pointer.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A grouped monthly bar chart (this year vs last year) with toggleable legend series, a hovered-month tooltip, and a lens glint on the active bar.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento grid
items.description: An asymmetric five-tile feature grid where every tile runs its own small live illustration: packets on a sync graph, a typing search, webhook retries, an access stack and a latency waveform.

items.name: blur-in-text
items.title: Blur-in text
items.description: A pull quote whose letters sharpen in sequence as it enters the viewport, with the attribution settling in after the last letter.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb trail that folds long paths behind an expanding ellipsis, with real links, a current-page marker and a lens dot.

items.name: changelog-section
items.title: Changelog Section
items.description: A release timeline where each version expands in place to list its New, Improved and Fixed changes. The rail draws down as entries enter, and the newest release carries a lens dot and a Latest badge.

items.name: conversion-funnel
items.title: Conversion funnel
items.description: Visitors to paid with narrowing bars that fill in cascade, step-to-step drop-off percentages, and a slow flow shimmer on hover.

items.name: copy-morph
items.title: Copy morph
items.description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button whose sheets fold away as the check draws in, then swaps back after two seconds.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: CTA Section
items.description: A closing call to action with a headline, two actions and a copyable install command. The column settles in with a short stagger, and the copy button swaps to a check with a success border.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A sortable transactions table with animated row reordering, live search, and compact pagination.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A settings danger zone whose confirmation dialog springs in, traps focus, and restores the workspace with an inline undo.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Revenue by plan donut whose segments draw around the ring, with a count-up centre and a lens glint at the start angle.

items.name: dot-grid-background
items.title: Dot grid background
items.description: A dotted section background whose dots brighten around the pointer and breathe slowly, with children rendered on top and a calm static grid for reduced motion.

items.name: dot-pattern-background
items.title: Dot pattern background
items.description: A canvas of dots that lean away from the cursor and ease back into place, with children on top and a still grid under reduced motion.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: An invoice actions menu with a highlight that glides to the hovered item, staggered entries, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: A two-column FAQ with topic chips, questions that expand in place with a plus-to-minus toggle, inline code answers, and an empty-state route back to all questions.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature bento
items.description: A five-tile bento grid where each tile runs a small live illustration: a drawing sparkline, a ticking counter, a toggle, a progress ring, and a typing command line.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: A dropzone with click-to-browse, size validation, and file rows that animate a simulated upload to completion.

items.name: goal-progress
items.title: Goal progress
items.description: Quarter goals with linear progress bars that fill in sequence, milestone ticks, and a count-up percentage. A goal hitting 100% earns a quiet check mark and a soft ring pulse.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: A product hero with a staggered title, two actions and a browser-framed dashboard that tilts flat on scroll, while a revenue line draws itself inside.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A six-digit code input with per-digit focus lifting, paste and arrow-key handling, a resend timer, and a verified state.

items.name: kpi-counter
items.title: KPI counter
items.description: A row of KPI cards whose numbers spring into view, with delta badges and self-drawing sparklines.

items.name: live-feed
items.title: Live feed
items.description: A live activity feed where events slide in at the top, with relative timestamps, a pulsing live indicator, and pause on hover.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite two-row logo band drifting in opposite directions, with soft edge fades and pause on hover or focus.

items.name: moving-radio
items.title: Moving radio
items.description: A radio group with a dot that travels between options on a spring, updating a live schedule summary underneath.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number ticker
items.description: A large metric whose digits roll into place when scrolled into view, with switchable metrics, a delta and a replay control.

items.name: orbiting-icons
items.title: Orbiting icons
items.description: Three counter-rotating rings of integration icons orbit a lens centre; hover, focus or tap a node to hold the orbit and read what it connects.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A pagination bar with a sliding active page, compressed page ranges, disabled edge arrows, a position rail and a range summary.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An export popover that grows from its trigger, with a sliding format switch, toggles, and a live confirmation when the file is queued.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing toggle
items.description: Three pricing plans with a monthly/yearly switch: prices morph digit by digit, the yearly saving badge slides in, and the recommended plan carries a slow border light.

items.name: progress-bars
items.title: Progress bars
items.description: Workspace storage as one segmented bar that fills in cascade, with a warning tick, hover-synced legend rows and a count-up total.

items.name: radial-gauge
items.title: Radial gauge
items.description: A 240° radial gauge with a self-drawing arc, a sweeping needle whose tip is a lens glint dot, tick marks around the dial, a count-up score, and a label with a delta beneath.

items.name: radial-progress
items.title: Radial progress
items.description: Three concentric rings draw in sequence with a glint at each end; hovering an objective lifts its ring and counts the centre value to it.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling number
items.description: A credit balance whose digits roll up or down with the direction of the change, driven by a stepper and tied to a live usage bar.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer button
items.description: A button with a light sweep across the surface on entrance, hover and focus, plus a ripple that starts where you click.

items.name: shine-button
items.title: Shine button
items.description: A button with a thin moving light along its border on hover and focus, in default and outline variants, three sizes, and an anchor when given an href.

items.name: side-sheet
items.title: Side sheet
items.description: A deployment log that slides in from the right, with staggered build steps, a copyable commit SHA and a queued rollback.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A seat-pricing slider with a native range under a custom track, a lens thumb, tick marks and a live monthly total.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight card
items.description: A card that catches the pointer: a soft spotlight follows the cursor across the surface and lights a thin border around the edge.

items.name: spring-accordion
items.title: Spring accordion
items.description: A settings accordion whose rows open on a spring, the chevron turning as the panel unfolds.

items.name: spring-checkbox
items.title: Spring checkbox
items.description: A task checklist where every box springs, the check draws itself and a thin bar tracks what is done.

items.name: spring-switch
items.title: Spring switch
items.description: Notification rows with a physical switch: the knob glides on a spring, the track fills and a small live count follows.

items.name: stat-ticker
items.title: Stat ticker
items.description: A horizontally scrolling ticker of live stats (MRR, signups, conversion, NPS) that loops seamlessly, fades at the edges, and pauses on hover or focus.

items.name: stats-section
items.title: Stats Section
items.description: A quiet marketing stats band with four large numbers that count up on scroll, each paired with a trend and a thin animated underline.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A four-step setup stepper with a filling rail, completed checks, an animated detail panel and Back/Continue controls.

items.name: testimonial-marquee
items.title: Testimonial Marquee
items.description: Two rows of testimonial cards drift in opposite directions with soft edge fades, pausing on hover or focus. Star ratings, initials avatars and a calm static grid for reduced motion keep it readable.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: A heading whose words rise in with a soft blur-to-sharp, staggered as it enters the viewport, with the full text shown immediately under reduced motion.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt card
items.description: A dashboard card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer, with a moving light reflection and layered content that gains depth.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: A notification stack where new cards slide in on top, older ones tuck behind with a spring, and the oldest leaves on a timer that pauses on hover.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A segmented language switcher with a selection pill that slides between options, roving arrow-key focus, and a snippet that swaps in with a short slide.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A selection toolbar whose tooltips spring from each action's edge, with shortcuts, focus support and an Escape dismissal.

items.name: typing-headline
items.title: Typing headline
items.description: A headline with a rotating word typed and erased behind a caret, plus a quiet list that tracks the word currently in rotation.

items.name: uptime-status
items.title: Uptime status
items.description: A status page with three services, each shown as 90 daily bars that rise in with a wave, hover/focus tooltips with date and status, an overall uptime count-up, and a legend.
